rawRecord.name: MCPpedia Search
rawRecord.short_description: Enables discovery, evaluation, and comparison of 17,000+ MCP servers from the MCPpedia catalog with integrated security scoring.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides a search and evaluation interface into the MCPpedia catalog of over 17,000 MCP servers. It offers six tools for searching by keyword or category, retrieving detailed server information including CVE scan results, comparing servers across five scoring dimensions, generating ready-to-use install configurations, surfacing trending servers by category, and browsing the category tree. Security scoring covers maintenance, efficiency, documentation, and compatibility.
